scope: Automatic mip eligibility is generated from host storage facts. Valid 2D/cube queries return D3DOK_NOAUTOGEN when only generation is unavailable; creation still returns D3D_OK, preserves usage and exposes one level. Invalid levels, pools, dynamic combinations and volume autogen follow frozen SDK/Wine expectations. POINT/LINEAR/ANISOTROPIC state reaches the host, defaults honor enabled FP32 filtering, NONE is rejected and failed setters preserve state. New protocol 1.8 fields defer dirty generation and capture its filter per op; old eight-byte commands still generate immediately. Real anisotropic samplers and missing ColorFill mip invalidation are fixed. XP feature masks are explicitly simulated, with separate real GPU downsample/fallback/feature-off/order/write tests; no native Microsoft D3D9 HAL claim. Published retail DLLs are the exact accepted probe bytes. Remaining common windows/core, wrapper and stages 5/6 continue.
